subject: The difference is embarrassing
preview_text: I compared my relationship before and after using SoulPlan. The gap is huge. Here's what I found.
body_paragraphs: I cringe thinking about the old me. The one who'd stare at my phone on Friday night, scrolling for a date idea, coming up with nothing. My partner would ask what we're doing, and I'd say 'I don't know, what do you want to do?' That silence got old fast.

Then I started using SoulPlan. And the contrast is almost embarrassing. Before, we'd fall into the same dinner-and-a-movie rut. Now? Last week we did a surprise budget-friendly scavenger hunt at a local park. My partner thought I was a genius. They even said 'I feel like we're dating again.' That hit hard.

The feature that changed everything? The surprise date planner. One of us plans blind, the other gets surprised. It forces you to actually think about what they'd love, not just default to Netflix. Plus the date history tracker means we never repeat the same idea twice. It's like having a best friend who always knows the perfect spot.

Open the app right now and check your shared wishlist. Add one thing you've been dying to do together. Even if it's just for next weekend. P.S. The AI picks based on your interests, so it's scary good at guessing what you both actually want.
cta_text: Open SoulPlan and add to wishlist
